Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the family relationships and consumption rules—incorrectly treating the grandma’s brother’s daughter (an adult first cousin once removed) as a second cousin and excluding her, while not excluding the three actual second-cousin kids from the potato count. They also miscounted attendees (stating 12 adults instead of 11) and used the wrong potato weight (0.25 lb vs. the stated 0.5 lb per potato), resulting in the incorrect conclusion of 1 bag instead of the correct 2.
